title: Design Studio Selections Fee Schedule Note: Repeat-Visit Multiple on Consultation Fees
content:
A design consultation fee on a Design Studio Selections file is multiplied by a repeat-visit multiple set by the consultation fee lines already on the file when the fee is charged:

| Consultation fee lines already on the file | Repeat-visit multiple |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 1.5 |
| Exactly one | 1.25 |
| None | 1 |

*Note.* The lines counted are the design consultation fee lines on the file's selection sheet that exist before the fee being charged is booked.

*Hypothetical figures:* a fee of 200.00 before this multiple becomes 250.00 where exactly one consultation fee line is already on the file, and 300.00 where two or more are.
